_readme: Settings for the 3-dive day plan and the calendar (Project 4). All times in minutes unless noted. Edit freely: the app reads these from brief.json after the next build. Scores are 0-10 for one 10-minute state of the current at a site, indexed by flow level 1-5 (the per-site level shown in the app). They are first guesses and should be tuned to what Lowis and the captains actually want.

travel_min._note: Harbor to Ulong 45 and to Blue Corner 55 from Lowis (2026-11-17). Everything else estimated from straight-line distance at the same effective speed (~33 km/h) plus a few minutes, so check and correct.

scores._note: in / out = Malakal rising / falling shifted by the site lag (corners: direction along the wall not mapped yet). Arrays are flow levels 1..5.
